title: Jobs · Trust
purpose: Tests each month how good the outside AIs are.
description: Once a month it asks the outside AIs the same fixed, non-private questions through the AI Layer and scores their answers. It then adds a to-do item to review the results. It starts in test mode, where it only logs what it would do.
